---
name: Feature / Change Request
about: Request a new feature or controlled change
title: "[CHANGE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What do you want to change?
A clear description of the desired change.

## Why is this needed?
Business or technical reason.

## Which areas are affected?
- [ ] Homepage
- [ ] Landing pages
- [ ] Routes / URLs
- [ ] APIs
- [ ] Metadata / SEO
- [ ] Environment variables
- [ ] Build / config

## Risk level
- [ ] Low — isolated component, no route/SEO impact
- [ ] Medium — touches multiple files, possible route/SEO impact
- [ ] High — structural change, env vars, or production config

## Approval needed?
- [ ] No — small reversible change
- [ ] Yes — explain below

## Checklist
- [ ] I read the relevant `/ai-skills/` files before requesting.
- [ ] I understand that destructive changes require explicit approval.
